mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the methane supply was satisfying: it produced the first visible liquid and made the plant's purpose tangible.

leastWorthwhile.text: The final pairing was less engaging because it was the only offered action and its control-system purpose was not clear until the result.

surprise.text: The tanks' protective housings are distinct from their factory pressure and vacuum walls, a useful physical detail.

arbitrary.text: Combining two propellant tanks initially felt abstract; the result explained that it coordinated their controls without joining their circuits.

continue.text: Yes. The completed plant makes me curious how the return and the preserved discovery will unfold, though this chapter's mostly obvious choices offered limited decision-making.
